headline: Russia Allocates €500 Million to Build Two Kaliningrad Supply Ferries
summary: Russian Prime Minister Mikhail Mishustin announced a 47 billion ruble ($500+ million) investment to construct two large transport ferries. The vessels aim to secure uninterrupted maritime supply lines to Russia's Kaliningrad enclave on the Baltic Sea.
why: Kaliningrad is a strategically vital Russian exclave situated between NATO members Poland and Lithuania.

impacts.name: Russia
impacts.why: Russia allocated 47 billion rubles to build ferries for Kaliningrad cargo transport.
